_note: V3.5. ONE otherwise-valid source minus emission_t_per_twh -- the negative case for _validate_energy_sources()'s refusal, which the Task 2 review found shipped untested. from_dict() parses the missing key to the -1.0 sentinel and the loader refuses it: 0.0 tonnes per TWh on a gas station is a confident lie the emissions read would print for years. Every other field is valid so the missing key is the only error the loader can report.

sources.name: Gas CCGT without an emission figure
